decisions.reason: Withdrawing the sister fouling-detection system suggests that niche fell short of aspirations, but the automation variant fits the digital-monitoring strategy and may have absorbed C's function, so an expanding firm with slack can carry it a while longer.
The weir-dimensioning web tool costs little to run and steers engineering planners toward the firm's core weir hardware, so no shortfall is likely to trigger problemistic search.
The spring-controlled flap weir sits close to the established flood-control business, and in a growing industry it is too early to judge it against aspirations.
Energy management for water facilities directly supports the firm's strategic push toward networked, energy-efficient infrastructure, so slack justifies carrying it while results are still uncertain.
The overflow flap gate line has its own page and several models, which signals strong commitment to a product close to the firm's core business.
